audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 disagreed across layers: phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[6] read 'LeBlanc', and both contradicted the page's own late-game prose, which says full-build Ryze is nearly impossible to burst or catch.
audit.why: 53.65% over 1424 games with LeBlanc owning every early stage; the give-back is late, where Ryze's mana scaling and Realm Warp take over. Rows 0-5 are correct as they stand.
audit.corrected: Row 6 set to Ryze in both layers, with phases[6].why rewritten to match.

audit.why: Ryze has no level-6 combat spike — Realm Warp is a 3000-range portal on 180/160/140s, map pressure rather than damage — so LeBlanc's 6 and first-item windows are the real ones. Correctly reflected.
audit.corrected: Realm Warp restated as a portal rather than part of a 'root-ult chain'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two kit errors: spikes[0] called Overload a 'short Q range' (it is 1000, longer than Sigil's 700 and Chains' 925), and the page treated Rune Prison as an unconditional root.
audit.why: Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux is already on the target — otherwise it damages and slows. Spell Flux is on 3.5s down to 2.5s at 615 range, so the tell is the orb, not the cage. Telling a LeBlanc she out-ranges Ryze is the kind of advice that gets her killed walking up.
audit.corrected: Flux-before-root sequencing stated with both cooldowns; Overload's 1000 range stated and the spacing advice changed to breaking line of sight.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E ranges, cooldowns and text

audit.why: Rune Prison's 11s-to-9s and Spell Flux's 3.5s-to-2.5s are what decide whether a step-up is a trade or a death.

edits.before: Late LeBlanc picks: W the flank, chain the carry, mimic the exit — and vanish before the obituary prints.
edits.after: Full-build Ryze out-ranges and out-sustains the burst, and Realm Warp relocates fights you had already won.

edits.before: Full-build Ryze finally scales into a real threat with his root-ult chain and Realm Warp map pressure
edits.after: Full-build Ryze scales into a real threat with his Flux-fed roots and Realm Warp map pressure

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Check it before every step-up. - W Distortion (return) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Rune Prison (W): 11s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5, 615 range — it only roots if Spell Flux is already on you; without Flux it is a slow. - Spell Flux (E): 3.5s down to 2.5s, so the orb always comes first. - Realm Warp (R): 180s to 140s.

edits.before: Track Ryze’s Rune Prison (Root): Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Ryze’s Rune Prison (Root): it roots only through Spell Flux — no Flux on you, no root. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: It roots only if Spell Flux landed first, so dodge the orb and the cage is a slow at 615 range.

edits.before: Q the sigil, W the detonation, return before the answer — a half-bar round trip he experienced as weather.
edits.after: At 6 the mimicked chain doubles the root — spend it while Rune Prison sits on its 11-second cooldown.

edits.before: Trade into his one CC spell
Staying at the W landing spot for one more auto — the return timer is your champion; outliving it is optional.
edits.after: Ryze turns time into damage: every item and mana stack feeds his 1000-range Overload while your burst stays flat.

edits.before: Linger past the W return window. Trade into his one CC spell. Coast — your lead has a sell-by date. Treat your ultimate as a verdict, never as harassment.
edits.after: Linger past the W return window. Trade after Spell Flux lands. Coast — your lead has a sell-by date. Treat your ultimate as a verdict, never as harassment.

edits.before: Ryze wins by landing Rune Prison (Root), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Ryze wins by Fluxing you first, rooting with Rune Prison, and out-ranging your step-up with 1000-range Overload.

edits.before: Carry through picks — one chained carry per objective; your job is the flank angle and the discipline to leave after.
edits.after: Carry through picks — chain the carry before Ryze can Realm Warp the fight elsewhere; that portal is his peel.

edits.before: Full combo LeBlanc punishes Ryze's short Q range and lack of any early burst — he can't trade back before you've already reset behind Sigil.
edits.after: Full combo LeBlanc punishes Ryze's mana costs and his slow Flux setup — but Overload reaches 1000, so break line of sight rather than trying to out-range him.

edits.before: Full-build Ryze with Realm Warp and a fed root chain becomes nearly impossible to burst down or catch, and his teleport-flanks reshape the whole map.
edits.after: Full-build Ryze with Realm Warp and Flux-fed roots becomes nearly impossible to burst down or catch, and the portal moves his whole team 3000 units across the map.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 you already out-trade him — Ryze has almost no early kill pressure and burns mana fast, so poking him with Sigil-Q punishes every CS attempt. Keep pressing as he has no way to threaten you back before level 6.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 you already out-trade him — Ryze burns mana fast and his root needs Spell Flux on you first, so poke with Sigil the moment that orb is spent. Overload still reaches 1000 range, so trade from the side of the wave rather than in front of it.

edits.before: Once Ryze hits his mana-fueled power spikes with a couple of items, his root-into-ultimate chain becomes very hard to dodge and he can teleport-flank sidelanes to swing fights. Respect his range and root once he's scaled — your burst window has passed and you need picks or numbers to punish him now.
edits.after: Once Ryze hits his mana-fuelled spikes with a couple of items, the Flux-into-Rune-Prison root is very hard to dodge and Realm Warp drops his team into a sidelane 3000 units away. Respect his 1000-range poke once he has scaled — your burst window has passed and you need picks or numbers now.

edits.before: Scale to 3+ items where his root-snare-ult chain becomes unavoidable
edits.after: Scale to 3+ items where the Flux-fed root chain becomes unavoidable

notes: Row 6 was the cross-layer disagreement (full 'Skill' vs content 'LeBlanc') and both contradicted the page's own late prose; set to Ryze in both. Corrected two kit errors: Overload is 1000 range, not short, and Rune Prison only roots through Spell Flux — otherwise it is a slow. Realm Warp restated as a 3000-range ally portal rather than part of a 'root-ult chain'.
